2607.13292.title: Theory-Level Autoformalization: From Isolated Statements to Unified Formal Knowledge Bases
2607.13292.paper_summary: Autoformalization translates informal natural language into formal, machine-verifiable languages. While most work focuses on individual statements, real formalization efforts are inherently theory-level: they require an entire web of axioms, definitions, and lemmas before target theorems can even be stated. In this position paper, we argue for theory-level autoformalization: formalizing complete theories, including all their inter-dependencies, as structured libraries. We examine the significance of this shift, address alternative views, identify open challenges, and propose three promising paths forward. Our survey of autoformalization is available at https://github.com/marcusm117/Awesome-Autoformalization.
2607.13292.paper_summary_zh: 自動形式化將非正式的自然語言轉換為正式的、可由機器驗證的語言。雖然大多數工作集中在單個陳述上，但真正的形式化工作本質上是理論層面的：它們需要整個公理、定義和引理的網絡，才能陳述目標定理。在這篇立場文件中，我們主張理論層面的自動形式化：將完整的理論形式化，包括所有相互依賴的內容，作為結構化的庫。我們檢視這一轉變的重要性，解決替代觀點，識別開放挑戰，並提出三條有前景的前進路徑。我們的自動形式化調查可在 https://github.com/marcusm117/Awesome-Autoformalization 獲得。
